items.h: Jauan Jennings finishes with three receptions Sunday night
items.s: Jauan Jennings caught 3-of-6 targets for 20 yards in Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers. After missing the past two weeks, Jennings returned to the field against his former team Sunday night. The veteran receiver still didn't accomplish much for the Vikings despite playing over 75% of the offensive snaps. Jennings has largely been a non-factor this season.

Jennings caught three of six targets for 20 yards during Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers. Jennings made his return to action after missing two games with a calf injury. The 29-year-old reeled in a season-high three passes, while his six targets were also the most he's had in a game this year. The wide receiver has yet to exceed 40 receiving yards in contest, and Jennings hasn't scored a touchdown this season. His next chance to accomplish both feats will come in Week 12 versus the Falcons.

items.h: QB Switch to Boost Jauan Jennings In Week 11?
items.s: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Jauan Jennings (calf) has deep league appeal when his team plays his former squad, the San Francisco 49ers, in Week 11. The Vikings enriched their offense by adding quarterback Kirk Cousins at the trade deadline, but they sorely need another capable wide receiver to step up now that Jordan Addison (thumb) is out after undergoing surgery. Minnesota made do with Myles Price and Tai Felton a week ago in a win at Green Bay, though Jennings figures to be a significant upgrade over both and could see a big increase in routes run. items.h: Jauan Jennings Off the Week 11 Injury Report
items.s: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Jauan Jennings (calf) has been removed from the final Week 11 injury report on Friday and will play on Sunday night against the San Francisco 49ers in Mexico City. Jennings will return after a two-game absence due to a calf injury after practicing in full all week. The 29-year-old will be returning to a revenge game against his former team, and a bigger role awaits the former seventh-rounder now that Jordan Addison (thumb) is set to miss multiple weeks following thumb surgery. items.h: Jauan Jennings Feels Good, Set to Play This Weekend
items.s: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Jauan Jennings (calf), who has missed the last two games, said that his calf feels good and that he has been a full-go this week, according to Alec Lewis of The Athletic. "I'm excited for every game. I mean, it's the San Francisco 49ers. It's my old team. I can't wait. It's always my guys for life (over there). Can't wait to see them," Jennings said. The 29-year-old has been a full participant in both practices this week, so he is well on his way to suiting up against his former team, the 49ers, on Sunday night in Mexico City. Jennings (calf) practiced in full Wednesday. Jennings sat out the last two games due to a calf injury, but his return to all activity Wednesday gives the Vikings' receiving corps a boost after Jordan Addison was lost for at least a few weeks due to a broken thumb that required surgery. As for Jennings, he'll have a prime opportunity to work opposite No. 1 WR Justin Jefferson as he looks to build upon his 6-54-0 line on 10 targets in his six appearances this season.

items.h: Jauan Jennings (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
items.s: Jauan Jennings (calf) logged a full practice session on Wednesday. Jennings was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, putting him squarely on track to make his return this week after being sidelined by a calf issue last week. He still isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

Jauan Jennings (calf) took part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday. A calf injury left Jennings sidelined last week, but he was able to take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday, although it's still unclear in what capacity. His Week 11 status will likely be determined later in the week as the team evaluates his health after a few days of practice.

items.h: Vikings Hope Jauan Jennings Can Return Against Former Team
items.s: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Jauan Jennings (calf) could return from a two-game absence Sunday night against the San Francisco 49ers in Mexico City, according to ESPN's Kevin Seifert. Jennings played five seasons for San Francisco and caught 55 passes for 643 yards and a career-high nine touchdowns there last season. Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that he expected Jennings to return to practice this week. Jennings was limited on Thursday of Week 9 and missed the final two practices before sitting out against the Buffalo Bills. items.h: Jauan Jennings an Interesting Waiver Target With Teammate Injured
items.s: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Jauan Jennings (calf) was unable to suit up for Sunday's Week 10 matchup against the Green Bay Packers. Jennings has missed two games in a row, but his fantasy value might actually be on the rise. Fellow wideout Jordan Addison (thumb) could need surgery, which will likely require him to be placed on the Injured Reserve. Once healthy, Jennings could end up as the No. 2 option behind Justin Jefferson in this offense. The 29-year-old hasn't done much this season, with only six receptions for 54 yards in six games. Fantasy managers looking for help at wide receiver, so consider stashing Jennings in case he does see a larger role in the offense going forward.

Jennings (calf) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Green Bay. Jennings opened Week 10 prep with back-to-back DNP listings due to a calf injury and now will miss his second contest of the campaign. With Jordan Addison (thumb) listed as questionable heading into the weekend, Justin Jefferson, Myles Price and Tai Felton currently are the healthy wide receivers on the Vikings' active roster.
